description: This file defines the AugmentedAIRuntimeClient class for interacting with the Amazon Augmented AI Runtime service, extending the AwsClient class and declaring various methods for service operations and their async counterparts.

classes.name: AugmentedAIRuntimeClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with Amazon Augmented AI Runtime service, extending AwsClient and providing methods for operations such as deleteHumanLoop, describeHumanLoop, listHumanLoops, startHumanLoop, and stopHumanLoop, both synchronously and asynchronously.

methods.name: deleteHumanLoop
methods.description: Deletes a human loop in the Augmented AI service.

methods.name: describeHumanLoop
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific human loop.

methods.name: describeHumanLoopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific human loop.

methods.name: startHumanLoopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a new human loop.
